exercises.name: Smith squat, feet forward
exercises.note: [RP] rest-pause on final set. 3 ramp sets first. Feet ~30cm ahead of bar. Chest tall, hips straight down the rail, knees driving forward. If you feel glutes, hips drifted back. Rest 120s.

exercises.name: Seated leg press
exercises.note: 1 ramp set first. Feet low and narrow. Stop before lower back rounds. Rises to 4 working sets from week 7. Rest 120s.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat (rack)
exercises.note: Weeks 1-5 ONLY. 10-12 always, never past 2 RIR. No spotter — pattern maintenance, not loading. Retires at the deload.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.note: FST-7 finisher. Terminal for quads. 30-45s rest, squeeze at lockout during rest. Load fixed across all 7.

exercises.name: Cable woodchop
exercises.note: Superset with weighted crunch. No rest within the pair.

exercises.name: Weighted crunch
exercises.note: 45s between rounds.

exercises.name: Incline barbell or DB press
exercises.note: 3 ramp sets first. Upper chest leads the day. Rest 120s.

exercises.name: Flat DB press or machine press
exercises.note: [RP] rest-pause on final set. Machine is the better rest-pause vehicle if available.

exercises.name: Weighted dip
exercises.note: Counted as chest — torso leaning forward, elbows flared slightly. Upright with elbows tucked makes it a triceps movement instead.

exercises.name: Pec deck or cable crossover
exercises.note: FST-7 finisher. Terminal for chest. 30-45s rest.

exercises.name: Lying EZ-bar skullcrusher
exercises.note: Long head in the stretched position. Lower behind the forehead, not to the nose. Rest 60-90s.

exercises.name: Rope pushdown
exercises.note: Lateral and medial heads.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.note: Superset with cable crunch.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.note: 45s between rounds.

exercises.name: Chest-supported incline DB row
exercises.note: 3 ramp sets first. Bench ~30°, chest down, row to the hips. Support lets the lats be the limiter and lets you reach real failure alone. Rest 120s.

exercises.name: Wide-grip pulldown or pull-up
exercises.note: [RP] rest-pause on final set.

exercises.name: Landmine row
exercises.note: Free-loaded row, placed second where load is lower. Anchored end shortens the lever vs a barbell; neutral grip is friendlier on the shoulder.

exercises.name: Straight-arm pulldown
exercises.note: FST-7 finisher. Rambod's own choice for back sevens. Terminal. 30-45s rest.

exercises.name: EZ-bar or barbell curl
exercises.note: 2 ramp sets first. Rest 60-90s.

exercises.name: Incline DB curl
exercises.note: Stretched-position bias.

exercises.name: Hammer curl or machine preacher
exercises.note: Hammer for brachialis/brachioradialis, preacher for the short head — pick by what looks thinner.

exercises.name: Seated DB press or Smith shoulder press
exercises.note: [RP] rest-pause on final set. 3 ramp sets first. Rest 120s.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.note: WEAK POINT — placed second while fresh. Reps never leave 15-20. Rear delt does horizontal shoulder ABduction, not scapular retraction: arms move apart, shoulder blades stay still. Felt between the shoulder blades = too heavy, rhomboids taking over. Thumbs down or neutral, slight elbow bend, no end squeeze. Rest 45-60s.

exercises.name: Seated lateral raise
exercises.note: Seated removes the body English. Rest 45-60s.

exercises.name: Standing cable lateral raise
exercises.note: FST-7 finisher — ODD weeks. Even weeks swap to reverse pec deck. 30-45s rest.

exercises.name: Barbell or DB shrug
exercises.note: WEAK POINT. Full ROM: ears-to-shoulders, 2s hold at top, 3s lowering to a dead stretch. No rolling. Most people load 30% too heavy and lose half the range — that is why traps stall.

exercises.name: Behind-the-back barbell shrug or Smith shrug
exercises.note: Second trap angle. Bar behind the body keeps shoulders retracted.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.note: 3 ramp sets first. LEADS THE DAY deliberately — pre-exhausting the hams means the RDL needs far less load, keeping erectors intact for D1 and D3.

exercises.name: Barbell RDL
exercises.note: STOP AT 2 RIR — never to failure. 8-10 always. The only axially-loaded movement left in the block. A stimulus, not a contest.

exercises.name: Smith hip thrust
exercises.note: Glute-dominant.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.note: FST-7 finisher. Terminal. Different curl variation to the seated by design. 30-45s rest.

exercises.name: DB curl
exercises.note: Superset with overhead rope extension. No rest within the pair, 90s between rounds.

exercises.name: Overhead rope extension
exercises.note: Overhead rather than pushdown — loads the long head in the stretch.

rules.note: DELOAD — ~55% of week 5 loads, stop at 4+ RIR, no failure, no rest-pause, no ramp sets

weekOverrides.label: Even-week FST-7 rotation to rear delts

rules.note: EVEN WEEK — perform this as REVERSE PEC DECK instead (rear delt rotation)

weekOverrides.label: Post-deload — squat retired, leg press up, Block B rotation

rules.note: Raised to 4 working sets — replaces the retired back squat
